chunks: And Rifāʿah narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
The Night of al-Qadr is the beginning of the year, and it is its end.

key_terms.رِفَاعَةُ: Rifāʿah, the narrator transmitting this hadith
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of al-Qadr, the sacred night of divine decree

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says Laylat al-Qadr is the beginning and end of the year?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Laylat al-Qadr holds a defining relation to the yearly cycle, describing it as both the beginning and the end of the year. It highlights the immense significance of this night within the divine ordering of time and sacred worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2021 - Rifāʿa narrated from Imam (as) that Imam (as) said:
"The Night of Qadr is the beginning of the year and it is its end."
